This matrix disposes every Definition-of-Done box for the county registration and yearly licensing, first registration, titles and liens, renewal by mail and online, address and name changes on the registration, armed forces and disabled veteran exemptions, ownership documents for new and used vehicles bought in Hawaii, other states or abroad, temporary permits, license plate display and moped registration section; each entry names its box, disposition and evidence location.

Knowledge boxes resolve to the accepted part C chunk (ranked high-yield list, misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines); KG-hint boxes ride with the accepted part C-two chunk.

Market boxes resolve to the accepted parts E and E-two scoped statements; accuracy resolves to part D and the consolidated VERIFY list to part F.

The passing-standard box is not applicable: the manual states no passing standard, and part A records that official fact as terminal unknown rather than as pending verification.
